SearchAliases: to quench thirst by imagining plums
Senses.Explanation: The inherited imagining-plums story concerns relieving thirst with the thought of sour plums; Chan authors invoke it when words or imagined attainment substitute for what would actually satisfy the need. The allusion marks an ineffective imagined substitute, not an instruction to seek fruit.
